craft_notes: Sthāyin: preparation — path, purification, vein-cutting. Sanskrit-first: nyasya twice kept (placement IS the method); kramāt kramam kept joint-by-joint; brahmarandhravarti kept the destination. Rows: 9 (place/purify/place/cut chain), 2 (long compound brahmarandhravarti held), 1 ('is made to dwell at the brahmarandhra' closes — destination end-weight). Close: 'is made to dwell at the brahmarandhra.' Rejected: summarizing the chain — killed: the sequence is the rite; 'veins' for marmapāśās — killed: noose-image kept (pāśa). Read aloud: THE-whole-PATH PLACED-in-the-DIS-ci-ple, PUR-i-fied IN-or-DER, BLESS-ed-kā-la-RĀ-trī the-VEIN-CUT-ter SET BY-her, JOINT by-JOINT — VEIN-NOO-ses SPLIT, the-DIS-ciple's CON-scious-NESS is-MADE to-DWELL AT the-BRAH-ma-RAND-hra.

lines: The whole path placed in the disciple, purified in order,
blessed Kālarātrī the vein-cutter set by her, joint by joint —
is made to dwell at the brahmarandhra.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samastam adhvānaṃ śiṣye nyasya taṃ ca krameṇa śodhayitvā bhagavatīṃ kālarātrīm marmakartanīṃ nyasya tayā kramāt kramaṃ marmapāśān vibhidya brahmarandhravarti śiṣyacaitanyaṃ kuryāt

reads_against.argmap: What is done to the disciple before the full-offering? → Nyāsa of the adhvan, ordered purification, and Kālarātrī's joint-by-joint vein-cutting move the disciple's caitanya to the brahmarandhra.
c1_essence: The whole path placed in the disciple, Kālarātrī cuts the vein-nooses joint by joint until the disciple's consciousness dwells at the brahmarandhra.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
